lee_ops: Quick Q: switching snapshots + cold-object buckets to CMKs tonight. We're enforcing no account-wide kms:* and ephemeral grants for uploaders. Anything critical I should know?

nina_sec: Ensure CloudTrail is filtering CreateGrant/RetireGrant/Decrypt and that manifests are written next to objects (sha256 + key-id). Without manifests we can't correlate failed decrypts.

omar_infra: Rehydration jobs run on a separate worker pool that sometimes lasts 30m. Grants need TTL >= job heartbeat or orchestrator must refresh grants.\\n\nlee_ops: Good catch. We'll implement refresh in the orchestrator and set default TTL 1800s for now.

patchbot: Ticket ENC-3301 created: "CMK migration + ephemeral grant adoption" assigned to @omar_infra and @nina_sec. ETA 5h.

nina_sec: Also remove any legacy role with kms:* before flip. If removal has risk, create scoped replacement first.

omar_infra: I'll run a staging end-to-end: create grant -> upload -> manifest -> canary restore -> retire grant. Will post result.

lee_ops: Thanks. If staging passes we run cutover in the maintenance window. Tag @oncall when we start.
